players.bio: Brynjólfur Andersen Willumsson (born Brynjólfur Darri Willumsson; 12 August 2000) is an Icelandic professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Groningen and the Iceland national team.
Dick Lukkien (born 28 March 1972) is a Dutch football manager and former footballer. From 1991 to 1996 he played 90 times and scored once for BV Veendam. He then played for SVBO and Appingedam.

Elvis van der Laan (born 29 March 2008) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Groningen. As a youth player, van der Laan joined the youth academy of Swedish side BP. Following his stint there, he joined the youth academy of Swedish side IFK Göteborg in 2021.

Etienne Vaessen Burnet (born 26 July 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Groningen. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Suriname national team. He made his professional debut in the Eerste Divisie for RKC Waalwijk on 12 August 2016 in a game against FC Emmen.
Hans Hateboer (born 9 January 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Ligue 1 club Lyon, on loan from Rennes.
Hidde Jurjus (born 9 February 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Groningen.
Jacob Axel Per Ondrejka (born 2 September 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Italian Serie A club Parma and the Sweden national team.
Jorg Schreuders (born 9 September 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for FC Groningen.
Lovro Stubljar is a Slovenian football player, goalkeeper for Italian Serie A club Empoli.
Marco Rente (born 25 February 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Dutch Eerste Divisie club Groningen.
Noam Fritz Emeran (born 24 September 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Dutch Eredivisie club Groningen.
Oskar Zawada (born 1 February 1996) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club FC Groningen.
Pelle Boevink (born 6 January 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper.

Pelle Clement is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Eredivisie club FC Groningen. Born on 19 May 1996 in Amsterdam, he stands 1.77 metres tall and is known for his versatility in the middle of the pitch, playing as a holding, box-to-box, or attacking midfielder.
Stije Resink (born 28 May 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for FC Groningen.
Thijmen Blokzijl (born 25 February 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Groningen.
Tika de Jonge (born 11 March 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie side FC Groningen.
Travis Enrique Hernes (born 4 November 2005) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Groningen, on loan from Newcastle United.
Tygo Land (born 11 January 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a central or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club FC Groningen , on loan from PSV Eindhoven

Tyrique Mercera (born 19 December 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for FC Groningen. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team. Club career From South Holland he played as a youngster for Alphense Boys prior to joining the youth academy of SC Cambuur. In the summer of 2024 he signed a two year professional contract with the club.
Wouter Matthijs Prins (born 6 February 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie side FC Groningen.
